scientific_integrity: Exact all-parameter proof plus finite independent direct-game and gap-formula replay. Bounded exhaustive computations support the proof but do not independently validate infinite cases.
scientific_limitations: Finite oriented total cyclic orders with a fixed exhaustive partition into q named colours only. No statement about infinite hosts, partial circular orders, unnamed/reversal-identified colours, or a complete optimal-host census for all q,t. The eight-point extremal census is specific to q=2,t=3. The first-public date is that of the 2026 rank framework and does not attribute publication of this new theorem. Historical-priority risk from literature outside inspected sources remains; no independent mathematical validation.
title: Sharp coloured cyclic-order extension ranks and the first binary extremal census
